<a id="node-talas-saturator"></a>
### Saturator

<code>talas.saturator</code> · maturity <code>functionalSubset</code>
Vendor Talas · origin <code>builtIn</code>

Subset: a smooth threshold, not a clipper. Each of up to four audio lanes reads 0 below Threshold - TransitionWidth and rises along a smoothstep through 0.5 at Threshold to 1 at Threshold + TransitionWidth; Repressor gives 1 minus that. The output runs from 0 to 1, so a negative input gives 0 &#40;1 with Repressor&#41;. For symmetric soft clipping use a Waveshaper with the ATAN20 table.

<a id="node-talas-stereodispersiveresonator"></a>
### Stereo Dispersive Resonator

<code>talas.stereoDispersiveResonator</code> · maturity <code>utility</code>
Vendor Talas · origin <code>builtIn</code>

Talas utility: two comb loops a Detune apart ring at Frequency for Decay time, whatever Damping and Dispersion. Damping places the loop low-pass, it is not an amount: 1 leaves the loop open and 0 sets a 20 Hz cut-off that mutes the ring. The input is DC-blocked at 20 Hz.

### Audio Output

<code>talas.audioOutput</code> · maturity <code>utility</code>
Vendor Talas · origin <code>builtIn</code>

Talas utility.

| capability | declared value |
| --- | --- |
| Offline | <code>supported</code> via <code>legacyAdapter</code> |
| Prepared realtime | <code>supported</code> via <code>legacyAdapter</code> |
| Nested Sounds | <code>expanded</code> |
| State / reset | <code>stateless</code> / no |
| Typed events / transport | no / no |
| Latency | none |
| Resource access | <code>none</code> |
| Fan-in latency | <code>align</code> |
| Output layouts | mono, stereo |

**Inputs**

| id | type | required | rate | layout | edge | timeline | spectral format |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>audioIn</code> | <code>audio</code> | yes | <code>sample</code> | <code>mono</code> | <code>continuous</code> | yes | <code>notApplicable</code> |
| <code>rightIn</code> | <code>audio</code> | no | <code>sample</code> | <code>mono</code> | <code>continuous</code> | yes | <code>notApplicable</code> |

**Outputs**

None.

**Parameters**

None.

**Limitations**

- <code>offline-and-prepared-exact-binary64-mono-or-ordered-stereo-terminal-copy</code>
- <code>required-mono-audio-and-optional-mono-right-input-with-no-implicit-duplication-or-conversion</code>
- <code>compiler-owned-exact-descriptor-terminal-binding-producer-buffer-scope-latency-and-channel-index-authority</code>
- <code>allocation-free-whole-callback-candidate-publication</code>
- <code>physical-device-selection-channel-mapping-format-conversion-hardware-gain-clocking-and-exact-reference-semantics-unsupported</code>
